event: Commissioner Fay Vincent sends a memo to all teams adding steroids to the banned list, with no testing
quote: sent a memo to all teams stating that steroids had been added to the banned substance list

event: League and union agree on a new testing regime
quote: the league and union agreed in 2002 on a new testing regime

event: Steroid testing of major-league players begins as an anonymous pilot. If over 5% test positive, leaguewide testing with penalties follows in 2004
quote: if over 5% of players tested positive, leaguewide testing with penalties would follow in 2004
note: The share who tested positive is not stated on the page

event: The pilot leads to leaguewide testing. No player is suspended that season
quote: That pilot did result in leaguewide testing in 2004, although no player was suspended for use that season.

event: Canseco, Palmeiro, McGwire, Sosa and Schilling are summoned to testify before Congress
quote: summoned on March 17, 2005 to testify in front of Congress

event: Stricter policy at the start of the season: 10 games for a first positive, then 30, 60 and one year
quote: A first positive test resulted in a suspension of ten games
note: Exact day not stated; dated to the start of the 2005 season

event: Rafael Palmeiro tests positive and is suspended
quote: On August 1, 2005, Palmeiro tested positive for performing-enhancing substances and was suspended for ten days.

event: Owners and players approve 50 games for a first positive, 100 for a second, lifetime for a third
quote: a first positive test would result in a 50-game suspension, a second positive test would result in a 100-game suspension

event: George Mitchell is reported to lead an investigation into past steroid use
quote: would head an investigation into past steroid use by Major League Baseball players

event: The Mitchell Report is released, naming more than 80 former and current players
quote: released on December 13, 2007, named more than 80 former and current baseball players

event: Blood testing for HGH begins with spring training
quote: implemented blood testing for HGH beginning with spring training in 2012.
note: Exact day not stated; dated to spring training 2012

event: MLB and the union agree to random in-season HGH testing and a new testosterone test
quote: reached an agreement to add random, in season human growth hormone testing

event: Ryan Braun is suspended for the rest of the 2013 season in the Biogenesis case
quote: for the remainder of the 2013 season (65 games and the postseason)

event: Alex Rodriguez is suspended through the 2014 season (211 games at the time)
quote: was suspended through the 2014 season (211 games at the time of the decision)
note: Wikipedia's pages differ on 13 vs 14 total Biogenesis suspensions

event: Penalties rise to 80 games for a first positive, 162 for a second, lifetime for a third
quote: the penalties for a positive test would be increased to an 80-game suspension for the first offense
note: Paragraph carries a citation-needed tag on Wikipedia

event: Jenrry Mejia becomes the only player permanently banned under the policy
quote: became the only player to be permanently banned under the drug policy on February 12, 2016.

event: Testing resumes after the 99-day lockout ends
quote: which ended on March 10, 2022. Testing resumed at that time
